best_for.detail: $0 commission + HKD 15 platform fee per order → total HKD 15/order. Beats ZA Bank (HKD 18 platform fee/order despite $0 commission) and PADB (charges brokerage commission per trade).

best_for.detail: $0 brokerage commission + USD 0.0099/share platform fee (min USD 1.99/order). EleBank ties: USD 0.0049/share commission (min $0.99) + USD 0.005/share platform (min $1.00) = USD 0.0099/share, min USD 1.99/order. PADB charges USD 0.012/share = USD 2.40 at 200 shares.
